title: ui-prompt: create scaffolding prompt buttons
description: Create reusable scaffolding prompt button components that allow users to quickly insert predefined prompt templates into the prompt textarea. These buttons provide common prompt structures to accelerate task definition.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display scaffolding buttons adjacent to the prompt textarea
THE SYSTEM SHALL make scaffolding buttons accessible via keyboard navigation

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user clicks a scaffolding button
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL insert the corresponding prompt template at the cursor position in the textarea

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user hovers over a scaffolding button
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL display a tooltip preview of the prompt template

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow scaffolding buttons to be clickable
unwanted.because: inserting templates into a disabled field would violate form state integrity

unwanted.condition: IF the prompt template is empty
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT insert any content
unwanted.because: empty insertions would create unnecessary undo history entries

preconditions: The prompt templates configuration must be loaded before rendering buttons
The parent component must provide a callback for handling template insertion
postconditions: After clicking, the selected template text is inserted into the textarea
The textarea focus is restored after insertion
invariants: Button labels always reflect their associated template name
Only valid UTF-8 template strings are inserted

happy: Click a scaffolding button and verify template appears in textarea
Use keyboard to navigate to button and press Enter to insert template
error: Click button when textarea is disabled and verify no insertion occurs
Attempt to insert template when parent callback is undefined and handle gracefully

phase_0: Review existing button components in clarity-web/src/ui/
Check tooltip patterns in existing UI
phase_2: Create ScaffoldingButton component with label, template, and on_click props
Add tooltip support using existing tooltip component

similar: See Button component in ui/ for button patterns
